definitions.explanation: The process by which economies, companies, and societies become linked across national borders. Used of markets, supply chains, education, and culture alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グローバル{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The globalization of the economy is advancing.

examples.japanese: グローバル{化|か}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Competition has intensified as a result of globalization.

examples.japanese: グローバル{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: As globalization advances, companies are seeking talent from overseas.

notes:
⟦グローバル→グローバル：10847_guroobaru⟧ (global) + the suffix ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (-ization), which turns a noun or adjective into a name for the process of becoming that thing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- グローバル{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: globalization advances
- グローバル{化|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adapt to globalization
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グローバル{化|か}: economic globalization
- グローバル{化|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧: the wave of globalization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国際化|こくさいか}→国際化：29799_kokusaika⟧: internationalization — emphasizes dealings between distinct nations, while グローバル{化|か} suggests a single borderless system
- ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧: worldwide — an adjective describing scope, not a process
